name: proteinmpnn
tagline_zh: 给蛋白质骨架逆向设计氨基酸序列，固定界面残基重设计单链，或做温度扫描生成多序列。RFdiffusion 骨架直接可。
tagline_en: Inverse-fold backbones into sequences, redesign one chain while fixing interface residues, or sweep temperatures.
desc_en: Inverse-fold a protein backbone (PDB structure) into amino-acid sequence with ProteinMPNN (Dauparas et al. 2022, github.com/dauparas/ProteinMPNN). Reach for this skill to run sequence design on RFdiffusion backbones, to redesign one chain of a PDB while holding interface residues fixed, or to generate a temperature-swept set of sequences for downstream folding.
why_zh: 同类工具只给单条序列，它内置温度扫描和界面残基锁定，直接对接 RFdiffusion 骨架。
why_en: Unlike single-output tools, it sweeps temperature and locks interface residues, plugging straight into RFdiffusion backbones.
